SELECT M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX-M.SMT_NOT_CLEAN C_RECEVIED ,P.PRD_UNIT,D.SMD_QTY*SMD_UNIT_PRICE C_SUB_TOTAL ,M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX C_AMOUNT ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME)C_PRD_NAME ,M.SMT_TAX/T1.CNT C_AVG_TAX ,(M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX-M.SMT_NOT_CLEAN) /T1.CNT C_AVG_RECEIVED ,M.SMT_NOT_CLEAN/T1.CNT C_AVG_NOT_CLEAN ,(M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX) /T1.CNT C_AVG_AMOUNT ,T1.CNT ,M.* ,D.*,C.*,S.* FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN (SELECT M.SMT_NO,COUNT(*)CNT FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO GROUP BY M.SMT_NO)T1 ON M.SMT_NO=T1.SMT_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S

SELECT A.CUM_NO ,B.CUM_NAME ,S.SPR_COR_NAME,SPR_TEL,SPR_FAX,SPR_ADDR ,ISNULL(SUM(A.SMT_TOTAL),0) TOTAL_AR ,ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_AMOUNT),0) TOTAL_RECEIVED ,ISNULL(SUM(A.SMT_NOT_CLEAN),0) TOTAL_NOT_CLEAN ,ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_DISCOUNT),0) TOTAL_DISCOUNT ,CASE (ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_AMOUNT),0)+ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_DISCOUNT),0)) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_DISCOUNT),0)/(ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_AMOUNT),0)+ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_DISCOUNT),0))) * 100 END Discount_Ratio FROM TBL_SHIP A INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER B ON A.CUM_NO=B.CUM_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT C.SMT_NO ,ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_AMOUNT),0) ARD_AMOUNT ,ISNULL(SUM(C.ARD_DISCOUNT),0) ARD_DISCOUNT FROM TBL_AR_RECV_DT C GROUP BY C.SMT_NO ) C ON A.SMT_NO=C.SMT_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S

SELECT A.SUP_NO ,B.SUP_NAME ,S.SPR_COR_NAME,SPR_TEL,SPR_FAX,SPR_ADDR ,ISNULL(SUM(A.RCV_TOTAL),0) TOTAL_AP ,ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_AMOUNT),0) TOTAL_PAYED ,ISNULL(SUM(A.RCV_NOT_CLEAN),0) TOTAL_NOT_CLEAN ,ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_DISCOUNT),0) TOTAL_DISCOUNT ,CASE (ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_AMOUNT),0)+ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_DISCOUNT),0)) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_DISCOUNT),0)/(ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_AMOUNT),0)+ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_DISCOUNT),0))) * 100 END Discount_Ratio FROM TBL_PO_RECV A INNER JOIN TBL_SUPPLIER B ON A.SUP_NO=B.SUP_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT C.RCV_NO ,ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_AMOUNT),0) PAD_AMOUNT ,ISNULL(SUM(C.PAD_DISCOUNT),0) PAD_DISCOUNT FROM TBL_AP_PAY_DT C GROUP BY C.RCV_NO ) C ON A.RCV_NO=C.RCV_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S

SELECT M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX-M.SMT_NOT_CLEAN C_RECEVIED ,P.PRD_UNIT ,D.SMD_QTY*SMD_UNIT_PRICE C_SUB_TOTAL ,M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX C_AMOUNT ,D.SMD_COST * D.SMD_QTY C_SUBTOTAL_COST ,(D.SMD_QTY*SMD_UNIT_PRICE) - (D.SMD_COST * D.SMD_QTY) C_PROFIT ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME)C_PRD_NAME ,M.* ,D.*,C.*,S.* FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CASE T.TRN_TYPE WHEN 0 THEN '期初' WHEN 1 THEN '進貨' WHEN 2 THEN '銷貨' WHEN 3 THEN '調整' ELSE '不明' END C_TRN_TYPE ,P.PRD_NAME+ ' ('+P.PRD_NO+')' C_PRD_NAME ,T.*,S.* FROM TBL_TRANSACTION T INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON T.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S )T

SELECT C_SUB_TOTAL-C_COST C_PROFIT ,C_SUB_TOTAL * SPR_BONUS_SALE_RATE C_BONUS_SALE ,(C_SUB_TOTAL-C_COST) * SPR_BONUS_PROFIT_RATE C_BONUS_PROFIT ,(C_SUB_TOTAL * SPR_BONUS_SALE_RATE)+((C_SUB_TOTAL-C_COST) * SPR_BONUS_PROFIT_RATE) C_BONUS_ALL ,T.* FROM ( SELECT E.EPY_NAME ,D.SMD_QTY*SMD_UNIT_PRICE C_SUB_TOTAL ,(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST)*(1+P.PRD_EXT_COST_RATIO) C_COST ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME)C_PRD_NAME ,M.* ,D.SMD_SEQNO,D.PRD_NO,D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE,D.SMD_QTY ,C.CUM_NAME ,S.* FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S )T

SELECT C_SUB_TOTAL-C_COST C_PROFIT ,C_SUB_TOTAL * SPR_BONUS_SALE_RATE C_BONUS_SALE ,(C_SUB_TOTAL-C_COST) * SPR_BONUS_PROFIT_RATE C_BONUS_PROFIT ,(C_SUB_TOTAL * SPR_BONUS_SALE_RATE)+((C_SUB_TOTAL-C_COST) * SPR_BONUS_PROFIT_RATE) C_BONUS_ALL ,T.* FROM ( SELECT E.EPY_NAME ,D.SMD_QTY*SMD_UNIT_PRICE C_SUB_TOTAL ,(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST)*(1+P.PRD_EXT_COST_RATIO) C_COST ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME)C_PRD_NAME ,M.* ,D.SMD_SEQNO,D.PRD_NO,D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE,D.SMD_QTY ,C.CUM_NAME ,S.* FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S )T

SELECT D.PRD_NO , CASE SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE)-SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST))/SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE))*100 END C_RATE ,P.PRD_NAME ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY) C_QTY ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE) C_TOTAL ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST) C_COST ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE)-SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST) C_PROFIT ,S.SPR_COR_NAME,S.SPR_TEL,S.SPR_FAX FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S

SELECT M.CUM_NO ,C.CUM_NAME , CASE SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE)-SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST))/SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE)*100 END C_RATE ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY) C_QTY ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE) C_TOTAL ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST) C_COST ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE)-SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_COST) C_PROFIT ,S.SPR_COR_NAME,S.SPR_TEL,S.SPR_FAX FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S

SELECT A.DELIVER_NO,A.EPY_NAME,A.SMT_DATE,A.TOTAL,B.RETURN_TOTAL FROM ( SELECT DELIVER_NO,EPY_NAME,SMT_DATE ,SUM(TOTAL) TOTAL FROM ( SELECT 1 DELIVER ,B.SMD_SEQNO,A.SMT_DELIVER1 DELIVER_NO,C.EPY_NAME,A.SMT_DATE,A.SMT_NO ,B.SMD_QTY*B.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*0.5 TOTAL FROM TBL_SHIP a INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT B ON A.SMT_NO=B.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE C ON A.SMT_DELIVER1=C.EPY_NO WHERE B.SMD_QTY >0
UNION
SELECT 2 DELIVER ,B.SMD_SEQNO,A.SMT_DELIVER2 DELIVER_NO,C.EPY_NAME,A.SMT_DATE,A.SMT_NO ,B.SMD_QTY*B.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*0.5 TOTAL FROM TBL_SHIP a INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT B ON A.SMT_NO=B.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE C ON A.SMT_DELIVER2=C.EPY_NO WHERE B.SMD_QTY >0 ) A GROUP BY DELIVER_NO,EPY_NAME,SMT_DATE ) A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DELIVER_NO,EPY_NAME,SMT_DATE ,SUM(TOTAL) RETURN_TOTAL FROM ( SELECT 1 DELIVER ,B.SMD_SEQNO,A.SMT_DELIVER1 DELIVER_NO,C.EPY_NAME,A.SMT_DATE,A.SMT_NO ,B.SMD_QTY*B.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*0.5 TOTAL FROM TBL_SHIP a INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT B ON A.SMT_NO=B.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE C ON A.SMT_DELIVER1=C.EPY_NO WHERE B.SMD_QTY <0
UNION
SELECT 2 DELIVER ,B.SMD_SEQNO,A.SMT_DELIVER2 DELIVER_NO,C.EPY_NAME,A.SMT_DATE,A.SMT_NO ,B.SMD_QTY*B.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*0.5 TOTAL FROM TBL_SHIP a INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT B ON A.SMT_NO=B.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE C ON A.SMT_DELIVER2=C.EPY_NO WHERE B.SMD_QTY <0 ) A GROUP BY DELIVER_NO,EPY_NAME,SMT_DATE ) B ON A.DELIVER_NO=B.DELIVER_NO AND A.SMT_DATE=B.SMT_DATE

SELECT M.CUM_NO ,C.CUM_NAME ,C.CUM_UNIFORM_NO ,C.CUM_INV_ADDR ,SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*10) C_TOTAL ,C.CUM_INV_RATE ,ROUND(SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*10)*C.CUM_INV_RATE/1.05,0) C_INV_NET_AMOUNT ,ROUND(ROUND(SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*10)*C.CUM_INV_RATE/1.05,0)*.05,0) C_TAX ,ROUND(SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*10)*C.CUM_INV_RATE/1.05,0) +ROUND(ROUND(SUM(D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE*10)*C.CUM_INV_RATE/1.05,0)*.05,0) C_AMOUNT ,S.SPR_COR_NAME,S.SPR_TEL,S.SPR_FAX FROM TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO ,TBL_SYS_PARAM S

SELECT CAR_NO,SMT_DATE ,SUM(TOTAL) TOTAL,SUM(RETURN_TOTAL) RETURN_TOTAL FROM ( SELECT A.SMT_NO,B.SMD_SEQNO,C.CAR_NO,C.CAR_LICENSE_NO,CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.SMT_DATE,101)) SMT_DATE ,B.SMD_QTY*B.SMD_UNIT_PRICE TOTAL,0 RETURN_TOTAL FROM TBL_SHIP A INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT B ON A.SMT_NO=B.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CAR C ON A.CAR_NO = C.CAR_NO WHERE B.SMD_QTY >0 UNION SELECT A.SMT_NO,B.SMD_SEQNO,C.CAR_NO,C.CAR_LICENSE_NO,CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.SMT_DATE,101)) SMT_DATE ,0,B.SMD_QTY*B.SMD_UNIT_PRICE RETURN_TOTAL FROM TBL_SHIP A INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT B ON A.SMT_NO=B.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CAR C ON A.CAR_NO = C.CAR_NO WHERE B.SMD_QTY <0 ) A

SELECT SYS.*,M.*,D.*,C.*,E.* ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME) C_PROD_NAME ,D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE AS C_SUB_TOTAL ,M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX AS C_AMOUNT ,P.* FROM TBL_SYS_PARAM SYS,TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO

SELECT SYS.*,M.*,D.*,C.*,E.* ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME) C_PROD_NAME ,D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE AS C_SUB_TOTAL ,M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX AS C_AMOUNT FROM TBL_SYS_PARAM SYS,TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO

SELECT SYS.*,M.*,D.*,C.*,E.*,P.PRD_UNIT,E1.EPY_NAME DELIVER1,E2.EPY_NAME DELIVER2 ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME) C_PROD_NAME ,D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE AS C_SUB_TOTAL ,M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX AS C_AMOUNT FROM TBL_SYS_PARAM SYS,TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO LEFT JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E1 on M.SMT_DELIVER1= E1.EPY_NO LEFT JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E2 on M.SMT_DELIVER2= E2.EPY_NO

SELECT SYS.*,M.*,D.*,C.*,E.*,P.PRD_UNIT,E1.EPY_NAME DELIVER1,E2.EPY_NAME DELIVER2 ,ISNULL(D.SMD_PRD_NAME,P.PRD_NAME) C_PROD_NAME ,D.SMD_QTY*D.SMD_UNIT_PRICE AS C_SUB_TOTAL ,M.SMT_TOTAL+M.SMT_TAX AS C_AMOUNT FROM TBL_SYS_PARAM SYS,TBL_SHIP M INNER JOIN TBL_SHIP_DT D ON M.SMT_NO=D.SMT_NO INNER JOIN TBL_CUSTOMER C ON M.CUM_NO=C.CUM_NO INNER JOIN TBL_PRODUCT P ON D.PRD_NO=P.PRD_NO INNER JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E ON M.EPY_NO=E.EPY_NO LEFT JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E1 on M.SMT_DELIVER1= E1.EPY_NO LEFT JOIN TBL_EMPLOYE E2 on M.SMT_DELIVER2= E2.EPY_NO
